newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt interbank o/n, one week rates rise.
newsitem.headline: Egypt interbank o/n, one week rates rise.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound ranged between 7-7/8 and 8-1/2 percent in a moderately liquid private sector market on Sunday, higher than their range of six and 7-1/4 percent on Thursday, bankers said.
The market is normally tighter on Sunday, the first trading day of the week.
One-week rates also ranged higher at between eight and 8-1/2 percent from six and 7-1/4 percent.
Bankers said that public sector banks kept their official minimum lending rate steady at 10-1/2 percent.
